meta.title: 蝶泳“抬”不起来？再硬“抬”罚100次模仿
meta.title_en: Can't Lift Up in Butterfly? Stop 'Lifting' — or Do 100 Reps of Imitation
meta.topic: 游泳教学 · 蝶泳技术

scenes.context: 很多人蝶泳推水靠「抬」：数到三就抬、落，当然起不来。蝶泳推水的发力不是靠抬，而是靠「抛、推」。语域：游泳教学，先纠错。
sentences: 蝶泳推水的发力，不是靠抬。
The power in butterfly's push phase doesn't come from lifting.
push phase（推水）；doesn't come from lifting（不是靠抬）
很多人一二三到这儿，抬、落，你当然起不来。
A lot of people count one-two-three, lift and drop — of course you can't rise up.
lift and drop（抬落）
蝶泳的推水是靠抛、推出来。
The butterfly push comes from a throw-and-drive motion.
throw-and-drive（抛推）
paraphrase: 推水 → the push phase / the propulsion
抛推 → throw-and-drive / whip and push
scenes.speak: The power in butterfly's push phase doesn't come from lifting. A lot of people count one-two-three, lift and drop — of course you can't rise up. The butterfly push comes from a throw-and-drive motion.

scenes.context: 正确动作是抛、推出来，而不是推到这儿停、抬出来。抛推的力要一直带到后面。语域：游泳教学，动作对比。
sentences: 抛、推出来，而不是推到这儿停。
Throw and drive it out — don't stop mid-push and lift.
drive it out（推出来）；stop mid-push（推到一半停）
抬出来，我们再看一遍。
Stop lifting it out — let's watch again.
lifting it out（抬出来）
抛水的力带到后面，推出来。
Carry the throw momentum backward and drive out.
carry the momentum（带动量）；drive out（推出来）
paraphrase: 带到后面 → carry the momentum backward / follow through
推到一半停 → stop mid-push / cut the drive short
scenes.speak: Throw and drive it out — don't stop mid-push and lift. Stop lifting it out — let's watch again. Carry the throw momentum backward and drive out.

scenes.title_en: Keep the Power Flowing, Never Stop
scenes.context: 抛水的力要带到后面推出来，而不是抛水的力停住、然后抬起来。力量的传递必须连续。语域：游泳教学，发力纠正。
sentences: 抛水的力带到后面，推出来。
The throw's power carries through to the back and pushes you out.
carries through（贯穿）
而不是抛水的力停，然后抬起来。
Not: the power stops, and then you lift up.
the power stops（力停住）
力量传递要连续。
The power transfer has to be continuous.
power transfer（力量传递）；continuous（连续）
paraphrase: 贯穿 → carry through / flow through
力量连续 → continuous transfer / seamless power
scenes.speak: The throw's power carries through to the back and pushes you out. Not: the power stops, and then you lift up. The power transfer has to be continuous.

scenes.context: 短促收尾，用「解会了吗」检验理解。核心要点就是：别硬抬，用抛推。语域：游泳教学，口语收尾。
sentences: 不要再硬抬了。
Stop forcing the lift.
forcing the lift（硬抬）
蝶泳的发力在推，不在抬。
In butterfly, the power is in the drive, not the lift.
in the drive（在推）
解会了吗？
Did you get it?
get it（理解）
paraphrase: 硬抬 → force the lift / muscle it up
force the lift · muscle it up
理解了吗 → did you get it / does that click
scenes.speak: Stop forcing the lift. In butterfly, the power is in the drive, not the lift. Did you get it?

practice: The power in butterfly's push phase doesn't come from lifting.
Throw and drive it out — don't stop mid-push and lift.
The power transfer has to be continuous, not a stop-and-lift.
Stop forcing the lift — the power is in the drive. Did you get it?
pitfalls: The butterfly power is from raise.
The butterfly push comes from a throw-and-drive motion.
You can't up because you lift.
You can't rise because you're forcing the lift.
起不来用 can't rise / can't come up，加 forcing the lift 说明原因。
Push to here and stop, then lift.
The power should be continuous, don't stop it.
The power transfer has to be continuous.
「力量传递」是 power transfer，比 don't stop 更专业。
shifts: 说蝶泳发力只会 push water
用 throw-and-drive（抛推）、carry the momentum（带动量）、power transfer（力量传递）
说起不来只会 can't up
用 can't rise / forcing the lift（硬抬）、the power stops（力停住）
说动作要连贯只会 keep going
用 continuous（连续）、seamless（无缝）、follow through（收势贯穿）
